content: {"phoneNote":"Clean typographic hero works, but hyphenated breaks like „li-stin“ in the price table and the sticky header capturing mid-page make the long page feel less tidy than the first screen.","desktopNote":"Hero and contact sidebar read well, but the price table and CTA leave the right half of the page empty, creating dead bands between sections.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Turn off hyphenation in the price table and service descriptions (li-stin, par-kirišče, stro-kovne) and give price labels room so they don't wrap.","On desktop let the price table span the full content width or pair it with the urgency note in a right column to remove the empty right half.","Drop the duplicate „Navodila za pot“ link in the contact block (already in the header) and the repeated „Prevajanje Kolar“ line under the giant footer name."],"blockers":[]}
